title: Earth AI – Applied AI & Sciences
description: Building AI-powered planetary observation systems that monitor forest carbon, map surface water changes, and provide high-resolution geospatial intelligence.

title: Health AI – Applied AI & Sciences
description: Developing multimodal medical AI foundation models, automated screening for diabetic retinopathy, dermatology classification, and genomic variant calling.

title: Science AI – Applied AI & Sciences
description: Transforming molecular chemistry, protein structure prediction, materials discovery, and particle physics through neural simulation and physical inductive biases.

title: Sustainability & Crisis Resilience – Applied AI & Sciences
description: Operational flood forecasting covering over 460 million people globally, real-time wildfire boundary mapping via satellite imagery, and electrical grid optimization.

title: Algorithms & Theory – Foundational ML & Reasoning
description: Designing scalable algorithms for sublinear graph streaming, continuous optimization, differential privacy bounds, and combinatorial algorithm design.

title: Machine Intelligence – Foundational ML & Reasoning
description: Frontier multimodal reasoning models, test-time compute scaling, tree-search trajectory verification, and autonomous agent systems.

title: Machine Perception – Foundational ML & Reasoning
description: Audio, visual, and multimodal understanding, 3D neural scene reconstruction (NeRF/Gaussian Splatting), and real-time sensory perception for robotics.

title: Natural Language Processing – Foundational ML & Reasoning
description: Inventing the Transformer architecture, advancing multilingual machine translation across 1,000 languages, and scaling context windows to millions of tokens.

title: Information Retrieval – Foundational ML & Reasoning
description: Dense vector retrieval, semantic ranking, neural re-ranking, and next-generation search engine architecture for world knowledge access.

title: Quantum AI – Systems, Quantum & Society
description: Developing superconducting transmon quantum processors, demonstrating quantum error correction below surface code thresholds with Willow.

title: Responsible AI – Systems, Quantum & Society
description: Pioneering algorithmic fairness, red-teaming, mechanistic interpretability, watermarking for synthetic media (SynthID), and ethical AI principles.

title: Human-Computer Interaction & Visualization – Systems, Quantum & Society
description: Designing collaborative human-AI interactions, generative user interfaces, accessible assistive technologies, and high-dimensional data visualization.

title: Software & Hardware Systems – Systems, Quantum & Society
description: Architecting Google Tensor Processing Units (TPU v5p/Trillium), JAX compiler optimization, Borg distributed scheduling, and high-performance datacenter networks.

title: Attention Is All You Need
description: NeurIPS 2017 (Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems) - Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar. The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent or convolutional neural networks in an encoder-decoder configuration. We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely. Experiments on two machine translation tasks show these models to be superior in quality while being more parallelizable and requiring significantly less time to train.

title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold with Willow
description: Nature 2024 / Physical Review X - Google Quantum AI, Hartmut Neven, Julian Kelly. Building a fault-tolerant quantum computer requires physical error rates below the threshold where increasing code distance exponentially reduces logical error rates. Here we demonstrate a 105-qubit superconducting quantum processor named Willow, achieving distance-3, distance-5, and distance-7 surface code memory below the fault-tolerance threshold, halving the logical error rate with each step in code size.

title: Accurate Structure Prediction of Biomolecular Interactions with AlphaFold 3
description: Nature 2024 - Josh Abramson, Jonas Adler, Jack Dunger. Here we introduce AlphaFold 3, with a substantially updated diffusion-based architecture capable of predicting the joint structure of complexes including proteins, nucleic acids (DNA and RNA), small molecules, ions, and chemical modifications. AlphaFold 3 achieves unprecedented accuracy across diverse biomolecular interactions, substantially improving protein-ligand binding pose prediction compared with traditional docking tools.

title: Gemini: A Family of Highly Capable Multimodal Models
description: Google DeepMind Technical Report / arXiv:2312.11805 - Gemini Team, Jeff Dean, Demis Hassabis. We present Gemini, a new family of highly capable multimodal models trained jointly across image, audio, video, and text modalities. Gemini Ultra achieves state-of-the-art results on 30 of 32 widely-used academic benchmarks, including being the first model to outperform human experts on MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding) with a score of 90.04%.

title: Learning Skillful Medium-Range Global Weather Forecasting with GraphCast
description: Science 2023 - Remi Lam, Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Matthew Willson. Global medium-range weather forecasting is critical to decision-making across society. We introduce GraphCast, a machine learning-based weather forecasting system that generates 10-day global forecasts at 0.25-degree resolution in under one minute on a single TPU. GraphCast outperforms the world's premier operational deterministic system on 90.3% of 1,380 verification targets.

title: Capabilities of Gemini Models in Medicine
description: arXiv preprint arXiv:2404.18416 - Khaled Saab, Tao Tu, Wei-Hung Weng. Generalist multimodal AI models have the potential to assist clinicians across diverse diagnostic and operational tasks. We present Med-Gemini, a family of multimodal models fine-tuned and equipped with web-search retrieval and long-context capabilities for clinical medicine. Med-Gemini achieves 91.1% on MedQA (USMLE), outperforming previous state-of-the-art models while demonstrating physician-level performance in radiology report generation and clinical summarization.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
description: NAACL-HLT 2019 - Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee. We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks.

title: TPU v4: An Optically Reconfigurable Supercomputer for Machine Learning with Hardware Support for Embeddings
description: ISCA 2023 (ACM/IEEE International Symposium on Computer Architecture) - Norm Jouppi, George Kurian, Sheng Li. We describe Google's TPU v4 supercomputer, which integrates 4,096 chips interconnected via custom optical circuit switches (OCS) to dynamically configure topologies. TPU v4 supercomputers provide 10x speedup and 2-3x better energy efficiency compared to contemporary contemporary accelerators, powering Google's most demanding training workloads including PaLM and Gemini.

title: Project Willow: Next-Generation Superconducting Quantum Processor
description: Willow introduces 105 superconducting transmons with unprecedented gate fidelities (>99.9%), demonstrating real-time fault-tolerant surface code error correction below the physical threshold. Willow cuts logical error rates in half as code distance increases from 3 to 5 to 7.

title: Project AlphaFold: AI for Biomolecular Interaction & Structure Prediction
description: AlphaFold 3 predicts the structures and interactions of all life's molecules: proteins, nucleic acids, ligands, and post-translational modifications. Over 2 million researchers across 190 countries have utilized the AlphaFold database to accelerate biological discovery.

title: Project GraphCast: AI-Powered Global Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
description: GraphCast delivers 10-day global atmospheric forecasts at 0.25-degree resolution in under a minute, predicting cyclone tracks, atmospheric rivers, and extreme heat waves with higher accuracy than top numerical weather prediction supercomputers.

title: Project Med-Gemini: Specialized Multimodal Foundation Models for Medicine
description: Med-Gemini equips foundational multimodal architectures with medical web search grounding, specialized radiology fine-tuning, and long-context clinical record synthesis, surpassing human physician benchmarks on USMLE MedQA.

title: Project Earth AI & FloodHub: Global Crisis Resilience & Early Warning Systems
description: Combining satellite imagery, hydrological sensor telemetry, and physics-informed neural networks to provide riverine flood forecasts up to 7 days in advance across 80+ countries covering 460M people, alongside real-time wildfire tracking.

title: Deep Review: AI-Powered Technical Synthesis & Peer Review Assistant
description: An intelligent technical synthesis tool that assists researchers in dissecting complex academic papers, identifying methodology assumptions, comparing experimental baselines, and verifying mathematical derivations.

title: Jeff Dean – Chief Scientist, Google
description: Jeff Dean is the Chief Scientist of Google, leading advanced AI research and computing infrastructure. He co-designed fundamental Google systems including MapReduce, BigTable, Spanner, TensorFlow, and early TPU architectures. Member of the National Academy of Engineering.

title: Demis Hassabis – CEO, Google DeepMind
description: Sir Demis Hassabis is the co-founder and CEO of Google DeepMind and Nobel Laureate in Chemistry (2024). He led pioneering projects including AlphaGo, AlphaZero, and AlphaFold, demonstrating that AI can solve grand biological challenges.

title: Hartmut Neven – VP of Engineering & Founder, Quantum AI
description: Hartmut Neven leads the Google Quantum AI laboratory in Santa Barbara, pioneering superconducting quantum processors from Sycamore to Willow, achieving quantum supremacy and demonstrating distance-7 surface code error suppression below threshold.

title: Pushmeet Kohli – VP of Research, Science & Robust AI
description: Pushmeet Kohli leads AI for Science initiatives at Google DeepMind, directing research at the interface of deep learning, quantum chemistry, structural biology (AlphaFold), and mathematical theorem proving (AlphaGeometry).

title: Corinna Cortes – VP of Research, Google New York
description: Corinna Cortes is a computer scientist renowned for co-inventing Support Vector Machines (SVM). She heads Google's research center in New York, conducting fundamental work in theoretical machine learning, online learning algorithms, and ranking.

title: Marian Croak – VP of Engineering, Responsible AI
description: Marian Croak is a Vice President of Engineering at Google leading the Responsible AI and Human-Centered Technology organization. She is an inductee into the National Inventors Hall of Fame and holds over 200 patents in telecommunications and computing.

title: John Jumper – Senior Staff Research Scientist & Director, AlphaFold
description: John Jumper is a Director at Google DeepMind and co-recipient of the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for computational protein structure prediction. He led the architecture design and training of AlphaFold 2 and AlphaFold 3.

title: Yossi Matias – VP of Engineering & Research
description: Yossi Matias is a Vice President of Engineering and Research at Google leading initiatives in FloodHub, conversational AI, and crisis response systems. Recipient of the Gödel Prize and ACM Fellow.

title: Quantum Error Correction Below the Surface Code Threshold with Willow
description: Hartmut Neven (2024-12-09) – Today, Google Quantum AI introduces Willow, our next-generation 105-qubit quantum processor that cuts logical error rates in half when moving from distance-3 to distance-5 and distance-7 surface codes.

title: AlphaFold 3: Accurately Predicting the Structure of All Life's Molecules
description: John Jumper & Demis Hassabis (2024-05-08) – AlphaFold 3 models interactions across proteins, DNA, RNA, ligands, and chemical modifications with unprecedented fidelity, launching via the free AlphaFold Server for scientists worldwide.

title: Advancing Clinical Reasoning and Medical Diagnosis with Med-Gemini
description: Alan Karthikesalingam & Vivek Natarajan (2024-04-25) – How equipping Gemini with fine-tuned web-search retrieval, specialized radiology decoders, and multimodal grounding sets new records in clinical problem-solving benchmarks.

title: GraphCast: AI Weather Forecasting in Under a Minute
description: Remi Lam & Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez (2023-11-14) – Operating at 0.25-degree resolution, GraphCast predicts severe weather tracks, atmospheric river precipitation, and temperature extremes up to 10 days ahead faster and more accurately than numerical baselines.

title: From 'Attention Is All You Need' to Frontier AI: Reflections on the Transformer
description: Jeff Dean (2024-06-12) – A look back at how an algorithmic insight in neural machine translation sparked the revolution in foundational multimodal reasoning and open research collaboration.
